source: When the well of concepts runs dry, a word in the nick of time will bring on a deluge. Words will help you get up an excellent argument, devise a system, even. They're beautiful things, words are, matters of faith, you know, and they're not to be robbed of even an iota.
translation: 当概念之井枯竭时，紧要关头的一句话就会带来洪水。言语可以帮助你提出精彩的论点，甚至设计一个系统。你知道，它们是美丽的东西，文字是，是信仰的东西，而且它们不能被剥夺，哪怕是一丁点。
